name: aangan-beat
prompt: Catchy upbeat modern pulse instrumental at exactly 104 BPM in 4/4 with a light Rajasthani desert folk colour: plucked kamaicha-like strings riff, dholak accents, punchy kick and claps, warm bass, starts immediately with the full beat, strong clear downbeats, steady beat throughout, no vocals

name: aangan-vo-1
text:
Many old Indian homes have a hole... right in the middle. [short pause] On purpose.
In the desert, at forty-five degrees... that hole kept the house cool.
It's called an aangan.
Bikaner. Twenty-first of June.
Researchers logged a two-hundred-fifty-year-old haveli through the day.
The courtyard? Forty-three degrees. Almost as hot as the street.
But the bedroom right next to it... never went above thirty. [pause] No AC.
Here's the trick. The courtyard is small and deep, with a sunshade on top... so the rooms around it stay in shade.
The walls are seventy centimetres thick. Heat takes about ten hours to get through... so it arrives at night, when the air outside is cooler.
And that courtyard is the only way air gets in... so it keeps moving.
Would you give up one room... for a hole in the middle?
